title: Outline chapter
description: A very large chapter number drawn only as a gold outline (-webkit-text-stroke) rises from behind a mask; the title slides in beside it and a rule draws under it. Plain CSS @keyframes, no library.

props.number: required, the chapter number as you want it shown, for example 04
props.title: required, 1-4 words

example.title: Slides and web
example.sub: Motion graphics on things that are not video.
